title: Landmark Observation Counts with unordered_map & map
hints: `++counts[o.landmark_id];` works because `operator[]` default-inserts 0 the first time it sees a key.
`operator[]` is non-const because it may insert. On a `const` map use `find` (or `count`/`contains`), and never call `[]` just to *look*.
mostObserved: iterating an `unordered_map` gives you no order, so apply the tie-break explicitly: `c > best || (c == best && id < best_id)`.
stableLandmarks: accumulate into a `std::map<int,int>`. Its iteration is sorted by key, so the output comes out ascending for free.
